scope: Sanitized row index for issue #54. Raw RAM-derived JSONL traces and runtime files are private; values below are limited to sample identifiers, counters, stable field values, and SHA-256 integrity references.

runtimeProvenance.inputMethod: Foreground-checked Project64 input helper; ordinary controls only. Runtime memory sampling used read-only process-memory reads; no guest-memory writes, cheats, or forced actions.
runtimeProvenance.rowAcceptance: Each cited row has an equal main-loop counter bracket. Rich object-pool trials additionally validate active/free-list structure. The earlier target-focused Goomba captures bracket selected Mario/target reads but do not claim whole-pool structural validation. Reads are non-atomic; events are bounded between samples. Pool identity is slot plus generation plus behavior; active-exit lastObject fields are the sampler previous periodic accepted snapshot, not necessarily the immediately preceding actor row.

reproduction.projectile: Remain inside the selected east overhead spawner radius (950 units) and sample selected actor fields continuously. Its native gate checks distance and vertical difference. Trial 14 began outside the radius at Mario XYZ [2564.076, 798.09094, 4935.4907] (row 0); after capture started, the foreground-checked helper held A+AnalogUp+AnalogRight for 700 ms, and Mario was at [2842.6208, 826.90906, 4974.9995] by spawn row 17, inside the radius. Validate resulting coordinates in fresh rows; do not infer direction from the key chord alone.
reproduction.goomba: Use the same BOB scene and a fresh nearby live Goomba; begin the sampler before a normal jump, then follow target action, Mario-object collision list, and active/free state by stable row.
